supportedClaims: Pinned fixed-parameter local numerical observations with persisted input, artifact hashes and Harness execution provenance.
outOfScope: Hardware performance, error-correction thresholds, quantum advantage and correctness proofs of numerical libraries.
Cross-machine bitwise reproducibility and claims outside the bounded numerical audit.

checks.criterion: Fixed rotated surface memory input: odd distance 3..11, rounds <=100, shots <=100000; only the acceptance scope is bounded.
Persisted facts satisfy the declared JSON Schema.
Recomputed binary64 request digest and all experiment fields bind to persisted input.
Stim task matches the input memory basis.
Packed failure bits have exactly the requested shot count, valid padding and matching success/failure totals.
Wilson score 95 percent interval with z=1.959963984540054 agrees within 1e-15.
Serialized circuit digest matches its bytes.
Independent request-only Stim circuit regeneration matches digest and structure.
Serialized detector error model digest matches its bytes.
Independent DEM regeneration matches digest and structure.
Same-machine pinned Stim/PyMatching replay matches samples, decoding and failure bits; unavailable or incompatible runtime remains conditional.
If physicalErrorRate=0, all shots succeed; otherwise the implication is vacuously satisfied and no noiseless claim is made.
Materializer atomically wrote and reread input/artifact bytes; digests and actual Harness call/result event range bind the evidence.
